text:
jess (customer): hey team, we rotated our API key this morning and now our client calls start getting 403s with 'insufficient_scope'. nothing else changed on the client side. urgent, this is impacting prod traffic :sob:

maria (support): sorry to hear that — can you paste a failing request (curl) + the full response body you see? also which region and which service (chat/generate/embeddings)?

jess (customer): region eu-west1, hitting /v1/generate. here's the repro: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":{"message":"insufficient_scope","code":403}}
we also see this in our client logs: `authz: token rejected - missing scopes`

ben (infra): quick check on the gateway logs for that key id shows repeated failures: `authz_lookup: key_id=alias/clients/42 scopes=NULL` — looks like the API gateway couldn't find scopes metadata for the new secret.

secrets-bot: rotation-job created secret path `secret/data/api-keys/client-42/rev2` at 2026-03-15T09:12:34Z (trigger=scheduled-rotation). metadata: {note: automated rotation} (no scopes field present).

sam (eng-runtime): this matches a known failure mode — our permission model performs a metadata lookup in Vault for a `scopes` attribute attached to the key. if the rotation job writes only the secret blob and omits the `scopes` metadata, the gateway treats scopes as NULL -> 403. sounds like the new key was created without the `scopes` attachment.

maria (support): ok steps: 1) can you confirm `vault kv get secret/data/api-keys/client-42/rev2` output (we need to see if scopes are present) 2) while we patch rotation, try swapping to the fallback key (old key) if available so traffic recovers 3) we can hotfix gateway to accept keys that inherit scopes from previous version for a short window.

jess (customer): i ran `vault kv get secret/data/api-keys/client-42/rev2` and it returns only `value` and `created_at`, no `scopes`. old path `secret/data/api-keys/client-42/rev1` has scopes ["generate","embeddings"].

sam (eng-runtime): confirmed root cause. rotation job call looks like: ```vault kv put secret/data/api-keys/client-42 value="<enc>"``` which overwrites the whole data map. the previous rotation utility used a JSON write that preserved metadata fields. fix: update rotation to `vault kv put secret/data/api-keys/client-42 value="<enc>" scopes='["generate","embeddings"]'` or better, read previous `scopes` and carry it forward.

ben (infra): mitigation plan: 1) patch rotation job ASAP to copy `scopes` from previous version and re-run for the affected key 2) trigger a `redwoodctl cache purge authz client-42` (this forces gateway to reload metadata) 3) if clients still 403, restart the gateway pods `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/api-gateway` — note: restart ~1m drain per pod.

maria (support): assigning to @sam to push the rotation fix (small change in the CI job). @ben will run the cache purge and follow up here when done. jess — we'll keep you updated, ETA for mitigation ~20-30m.

sam (eng-runtime): opened PR https://git.internal/redwood/infra/rotate-key-job/pull/87 that reads `scopes` from latest version and re-applies. i'll run a manual rotate for client-42 after merge. 

ben (infra): cache purge executed: `redwoodctl cache purge authz client-42` -> purge acknowledged by gateway. then I re-ran rotation with scopes copied. gateway logs now show `authz_lookup: key_id=alias/clients/42 scopes=[generate, embeddings]`

jess (customer): confirmed — client calls now return 200 and generate responses. huge thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria (support): great, closing the incident once we verify no other clients hit this. next steps: sam will harden the rotation job, ben will add a smoke-check that verifies `scopes` present post-rotation, and i'll notify customers who rotated keys in the last 24h.

sam (eng-runtime): long term we'll add a post-rotation hook that runs `authz` smoke tests and optionally rewraps KMS aliases. adding to backlog: INFRA-912.

jess (customer): thanks again — appreciated the quick turnaround!
